S0 had no matching TGA declaration, so this uncovered surface was introduced by the commit rather than inherited.
evidence: The diff creates `std/tga/decode_tga.wuffs` and declares `pub struct decoder? implements base.image_decoder`.
The new decoder exposes input-facing entry points `decoder.decode_image_config`, `decoder.decode_frame_config`, and `decoder.decode_frame`.
The source explicitly defines `call_sequence` states `0x00`, `0x03`, `0x04`, and `0xFF`, with transitions through DIC, DFC, DF, and `restart_frame`.
`decoder.restart_frame` adds separately controllable `index` and `io_position` semantics and can return `#bad call sequence`, `#bad argument`, or reset state to `3`.
H0's C paths only call `wuffs_json__decoder__initialize` and `wuffs_json__decoder__decode_tokens`; its C++ path only calls `wuffs_aux::DecodeJson`.
H0 defines only JSON modules (`WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__JSON` and `WUFFS_CONFIG__MODULE__AUX__JSON`) and contains no TGA decoder initialization or dispatch.

recommended_action: Add a TGA image-decoder fuzz harness, or extend an existing image-decoder harness to instantiate `wuffs_tga__decoder` and drive `decode_image_config`, `decode_frame_config`, `decode_frame`, and `restart_frame` across valid and invalid call sequences, positions, pixel-buffer configurations, blend values, and arbitrary source bytes.
